name: GenExam
intro: GenExam 是覆盖十个学科的多学科文生图考试基准。它以参考真值图、考试式提示和原子评分点衡量模型生成包含复杂学科知识图像的能力，并提供严格分与宽松分。
build_method: 多源图像收集, GPT-5筛选与提示起草, 博士标注员交叉复核
task_type: 文生图, 多学科考试评测
eval_feature: 原子评分点, 参考图GPT-5裁判, 严格与宽松计分
build_method_en: Multi-source Image Collection, GPT-5 Filtering and Prompt Drafting, Cross-validation by PhD Annotators
eval_feature_en: Atomic Scoring Points, Reference-image GPT-5 Judge, Strict and Relaxed Scoring
intro_en: GenExam is a multidisciplinary text-to-image examination benchmark spanning ten subjects. Reference images, exam-style prompts, and atomic scoring points measure whether models can generate complex images containing subject knowledge, with both strict and relaxed scores.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.14232 and the official OpenGVLab/GenExam repository. The benchmark defines an ISCED-F-aligned four-level taxonomy, gathers about 40K candidate images from exam/textbook Web search and seven subject-knowledge datasets, removes technical defects, then uses GPT-5 to retain 6.5K high-value images. GPT-5 drafts exam prompts and weighted yes/no scoring points; three PhD annotators cross-validate the image, prompt, and scoring points before the 1,000-item release. GenExam-Mini uses level-three stratified sampling and has 487 items in the official results. For evaluation, one generated image is judged against the reference image by GPT-5: weighted semantic correctness is 0–1, while spelling, logical consistency, and readability are each 0–2. Strict correctness requires semantic 1 and all three auxiliary scores 2; the relaxed score uses weights 0.7/0.1/0.1/0.1.
